context: Tests whether the research skill infers the correct depth level from the prompt, dispatches parallel subagents in a single message, writes a compact artifact, and stops without proceeding to planning.

checklist.name: Depth inferred
checklist.description: Depth level is inferred from prompt as Quick or Standard (not Deep) for a single well-bounded module

checklist.name: Parallel dispatch
checklist.description: Multiple subagents are dispatched in parallel in a single message, not sequentially

checklist.name: Artifact written
checklist.description: Research artifact is written to docs/plans/ with YYYY-MM-DD naming and -research.md suffix

checklist.name: Artifact length
checklist.description: Research artifact stays under approximately 200 lines

checklist.name: Stops after research
checklist.description: Skill stops after writing the artifact without proceeding to planning or implementation
